mapper.select: SELECT request_id, TO_CHAR(request_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS request_date, TO_CHAR(approve_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS approve_date, request_status, memberIdx, content FROM ( SELECT request_id, request_date, approve_date, request_status, memberIdx, content FROM Club_Request WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx} ORDER BY request_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
